claim_boundary: Crystallographic basin occupancy, persistent reverse jumps, and temporally connected multi-ion strings are reported descriptively. Cooperative motion is claimed only when the observed connected-event fraction exceeds the preregistered per-ion circular-time null model and remains robust to the stated sensitivity grid.

analysis.null_model: independent uniform circular time shift for each labelled ion

quality_gate.failure_action: Do not interpret site, reverse-jump, or string statistics. Refine a separately versioned assignment model without inspecting configuration-level transport correlations, then rerun the sensitivity grid.
